translations.1: At dawn, the cloud and mist outside the mountain gate had not yet dispersed.
translations.10: Senior Sister Zeng, Elder Qin wants you at the ward. Wanqi Senior Brother and I will stay here.
translations.11: Alright. When Miss Qiu wakes up, come and get me at once.
translations.12: Wanqi Jing scratched his head, then turned and ran toward the foot of the mountain.
translations.13: Xie Xuan stood at the hall doorway, her sword still sheathed, yet the lamplight dimmed for a moment.
translations.14: Elder Qin, I trust you have been well. By the pavilion master's order, I have come to collect three shares of qi stones.
translations.15: Three parts? The qi stones were hoarded by our sect through hard work. When did an outsider get the right to take them?
translations.16: The ward has already cracked, so the qi stones are not safe in your hands. I will come back in three days.
translations.17: Xie Xuan let out a cold laugh, turned, and walked away without looking back.
translations.18: Three days means three days. I never break my word.
translations.19: Elder Qin stroked his beard and glanced at Chou Shuang, who lay asleep on the couch.
translations.2: Yunzhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough qi stones?
translations.20: Elder, let me go guard the ward. Yue Chuan is looking after Miss Chou, so I can be spared.
translations.21: At last, he nodded and took a jade talisman from his sleeve.
translations.22: This is the array-eye token. Guard it, and only then have you truly guarded your Dao.
translations.23: Yue Chuan pushed the herb pouch into Yun Zhou's arms and murmured a few more instructions.
translations.24: At the mountain gate, Wan Qi Jing handed over a straw raincoat.
translations.25: Thank you, Senior Brother Wan. Miss Qiu has woken up, so please convey my thanks to her.
translations.26: Shan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the formation-eye token securely against his body.
translations.27: In the hall, Qiu Shuang slowly opened her eyes.
translations.28: You're awake, good. You've been out for a whole day, so don't move around ▼
translations.29: Qiu Shuang struggled to sit up and looked toward the cracked sky beyond the window.
translations.3: Brought three bags, all the best from the back mountain.
translations.30: No one noticed that the letter in her sleeve bore Xie Xuan's seal.
translations.4: The ward cracked another seam last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep a wink.
translations.5: Before he could finish, Mòqí Jìng came racing up from the foot of the mountain.
translations.6: Gasping for breath, he said there was a young woman lying by the road at the foot of the mountain.
translations.7: Bring her up quickly. Ruoshui, go fetch the healing pills.
translations.8: Wan Qi Jing rushed into the great hall with an unconscious woman on his back, the iron token at his waist engraved: Qiu Shuang.
translations.9: It's not serious, she's just run out of spiritual energy. Give her one Spirit-Return Pill and she'll be fine.
